purpose: Prove the combined order, gates, evidence and recovery contract for a provider rollback and credential rotation without touching a provider or using a credential.

rehearsalSteps.action: verify exact candidate and rollback identities
open simulated dual-validation window with opaque test identifiers only
simulate rollback health and identity acceptance
close simulated dual-validation window and retire candidate identifier

failClosedRules: A missing or mismatched candidate identity stops before any credential or deploy action.
A missing rollback identity stops the rehearsal and keeps the candidate unapproved.
No credential value, deploy hook, provider token or secret may enter source, evidence or logs.
A rehearsal is never deployment authorization and never proves a live provider mutation.
Public profile publication, featuring, outreach, opportunity routing and claim approval stay closed.
